blocks.text: American pop rock band LANY announced the cancellation of its Cebu concert hours before it was set to begin, citing safety concerns involving the roofing of the venue. “We regret to inform you that today’s LANY show in Cebu has been postponed to a later date due to significant safety issues regarding the roofing of the venue discovered after soundcheck,” concert promotion company Live Nation Philippines said in a statement released on Thursday, Nov. 12.
